cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random, sys
rng = random.Random(5)
svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(24)]
lines = []
for L, k in ((4,10),(4,10),(3,10),(3,10),(4,10),(3,10)):
    specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc[:24]) for _ in range(L)) for _ in range(k)]
    when = {'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}
    rules = [{'action':'allow','when':when}]
    queries = [[svc[0],svc[1],svc[2]]]
    lines.append(json.dumps({'services':svc,'rules':rules,'queries':queries}))
open('heavy.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print('written', len(lines))
EOF
/usr/bin/time -v python3 -I /workspace/submission/main.py < heavy.jsonl > heavy.out 2> heavy.time; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "Elapsed|Maximum resident|User time|System time" heavy.time; wc -c heavy.out; head -c 200 heavy.out
